label: Python with pyright
description: Type checks Python components with pyright and the project own configuration. Comes in by evidence: only when pyright is configured (pyrightconfig.json or [tool.pyright] in pyproject.toml). pyright is supplied by the project environment and is never installed during a run. Extends python-mypy-defaults (same pyright instance): where both are active, this one wins and the check is required, with the project's configuration only.
